privacy.description: Look up what this Workspace holds for an email address, to answer a GDPR access or erasure request. The lookup shows counts only.
privacy.eraseConfirmDescription: Erasure is permanent and cannot be undone. It removes the contact for this address with its visitors, events, tags and custom fields, and cancels its automation runs and queued mail. Delivery records to the address are anonymized and its captured messages are deleted. Unsubscribes and suppressions are kept so the person is never mailed again.
privacy.invalidEmail: This is not a valid email address.
privacy.lookupError: Could not look up the address.
privacy.membersOnly: Only owners and admins can handle privacy requests.
privacy.nothingFound: Nothing found for this address. It may have been erased already.
privacy.nothingHeld: Nothing is held for this address.

revenue.currencyDescription: Every revenue figure is shown in this currency. Revenue stays hidden until one is chosen.

revenue.loadError: Failed to load the revenue settings
revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.windowDescription: An order is credited to the message whose link its contact last clicked within this many days (1 to 90). A change applies only to orders that arrive afterwards.

sendCap.description: The platform sets the most messages this workspace may send in any 24 hours, across all its providers, transactional mail included. Messages beyond it wait until the 24-hour window frees up; transactional mail is never delayed. It is not a Provider limit, which you set for each provider.
sendCap.sentOf: Sent in the last 24 h: {{sent, number}} / {{perDay, number}}
sendCap.title: Send cap

settings.sendEventsDescription: The snippet above tracks page views in the browser. To send events yourself, use an SDK or the API.

sendingDomains.dkimHint: Authenticates your mail — required to send once enforced.

sendingDomains.title: Domains

trackingReason.hostTaken: Another workspace has already verified this host, so it stays pending here. Use a sending domain of your own, or ask the other workspace to release it.

settings.testEventDescription: Send a test event from your terminal, then watch it appear in the activity feed.
settings.timezoneDescription: The time zone your reports count days and hours in. Only an owner or admin can change it; a change applies to all history at once.

tokens.forbidden: Only workspace owners and admins can manage API tokens. Ask an owner or admin to do it for you.
tokens.revokeConfirmDescription: Applications using this token will immediately lose access.
tokens.secretNotice: Copy this token now — it won't be shown again.

settings.trackerHostDescription: Use the host under your own site's domain (for example track.example.com on www.example.com), so the script and the events come from your domain.
settings.trackingDescription: Paste this snippet into the <head> of your site to start collecting events. It loads the tracker without blocking the page, and calls such as _omq.push(['track', 'signed_up']) made before it has loaded are queued and sent once it is ready.
